Use case: stylized-concept. Single WALL BANNER, front MAIN view for Wonder Chess. Attached hero is STYLE ONLY, copy painterly semi-realistic3D material rendering and soft even light. No character.
A long deep royal blue #24468F cloth banner,1.9 metres wide and4.6 metres tall. ONE simple aged brass #B8923A SUN emblem centered on front upper-middle, matching the simple sun language on hero. Cloth hangs FLAT, straight and still, with only subtle vertical cloth folds. Lower edge has a deep symmetric fork/V notch making TWO downward points. A narrow aged-brass trim runs ONLY along the forked bottom edge. A plain straight brass rod at the top, minimal blunt capped ends, no ornate finials, no wall bracket, rope, mount, tassels, jewels, extra rod or backing. Back is entirely plain blue with no sun. Worn believable cloth with broad subtle wear, quiet limited palette, no tiny noisy detail or dramatic contrast.
Exact front perpendicular orthographic view. One isolated complete object centered in square1254x1254PNG; top rod at8% canvas height, fork tips bottom92%, clothwidth41.3% of overallheight, rod slightly wider than cloth. Generous margins. Solid plain #E6E6E6 light-grey background, soft even studio light, no wall/ground/floor, no cast/contact shadow, no scenery, no text/labels/logo, no people or character.
files.review: Main has plain rod, deep blue cloth, single brass sun and forked brass-trimmed bottom. Hangs flat, complete with margin.
